stem:
Parul watches the Sun after sunrise. It appears to move from east toward west across the sky.

Why does the Sun appear to move from east to west?

options.text: Earth rotates from west to east on its own axis.
Earth rotates from east to west on its own axis.
Earth revolves around the Sun once each year, and that alone causes the daily path.
The Sun orbits Earth from east to west each day.

teacher.key_rationale: The Sun appears to move east to west because Earth rotates west to east on its axis.
